title: helosciadium nodiflorum subsp. inundatum
intro: Helosciadium nodiflorum subsp. inundatum, commonly known as Marsh Hemlock, is a plant species that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various digestive issues, such as indigestion and bloating, due to its carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Hemlock include its ability to relieve flatulence, reduce inflammation, and act as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
